souple.regle: full refund up to 24 hours before arrival; after that, the first night is kept.

moderee.regle: full refund up to 5 days before arrival; 50% of the nights up to 24 hours before; no refund after that.

ferme.regle: full refund up to 30 days before arrival; 50% of the nights up to 7 days before; no refund after that.

politiqueAnnulation.reflexion: Cooling-off period: a booking cancelled within 48 hours, at least 7 days before arrival, is fully refunded. The service fee is only returned with a full refund.
